title: Collaboration Norms
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting collaboration norms to shared document collaboration setup with access and comment controls, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Set least-access sharing so only the people who need to edit can edit, and everyone else can view.
Assign section ownership so no two people work on the same part at the same time.
Use suggesting mode and comments so edits are visible and reversible, never silent overwrites.
Set an internal deadline ahead of the real one to leave time for review.
